item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong direct evidence on province-by-province, income-by-income, or gender-by-gender distribution of *economic* gains from Srettha’s policies. The best positive evidence is broad and indirect: universal cash transfers, inclusive rhetoric, and one major equality gain for LGBT people. The best negative evidence is more concrete in practice: dissenters, minority communities, and refugees still faced selective coercion, which cuts against genuinely fair distribution across groups.","evidence":[{"title":"Thailand’s cabinet approves $13.5 billion digital-wallet handout","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"April 23, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thailands-cabinet-approves-135-billion-digital-wallet-handout-3390007","summary":"The plan was a 10,000-baht transfer to 50 million Thais, which is the strongest evidence that Srettha tried to distribute gains broadly rather than only to regime supporters. It was universal in design, not narrowly targeted to a political base.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.1","5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Thai PM says digital-wallet scheme will spur jobs and manufacturing","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"July 11, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-pm-says-digital-wallet-scheme-will-spur-jobs-and-manufacturing-3514879","summary":"Srettha publicly framed the program as broad-based jobs and manufacturing support, not as a reward for loyalists. That is weak but relevant positive evidence for cross-class economic distribution.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Thailand’s flagship $14 billion handout hits implementation snags","publisher":"Reuters via Yahoo News","date":"August 1, 2024","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/thailands-flagship-14-billion-handout-072635149.html","summary":"Reuters reported delays and fiscal-risk criticism, which weakens the case that the policy was a clean fairness measure. It still matters because the government kept a politically salient universal program despite expert objections.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.7","5B.3","5B.6"]},{"title":"Victory: same-sex marriage in Thailand","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"June 18, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/victory-same-sex-marriage-thailand","summary":"Thailand’s Senate approved same-sex marriage under Srettha’s government. This is the clearest positive evidence for fairer treatment of an excluded gender/identity group.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.4","5B.6"]},{"title":"Thailand: New government slow to protect rights","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/thailand-new-government-slow-protect-rights","summary":"HRW said the government was still pursuing politically motivated prosecutions of peaceful protesters and monarchy critics. That is negative evidence for fair distribution of state benefits and protections across groups, because dissenters were not treated equally.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.7","5B.9"]},{"title":"Thailand: Investigate detained youth activist’s death","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"May 23, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/23/thailand-investigate-detained-youth-activists-death","summary":"HRW said hundreds of monarchy critics were in pretrial detention. This supports the negative side: unpopular political groups were still facing selective coercion rather than equal treatment.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.7","5B.9"]},{"title":"Thailand: Swap Mart targets foreign dissidents, refugees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"May 15, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/15/thailand-swap-mart-targets-foreign-dissidents-refugees","summary":"HRW described harassment, surveillance, and forced returns against dissidents and refugees. That is strong negative evidence for fairness across groups, especially toward vulnerable outsiders.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","5B.5"]},{"title":"Thailand: Last-ditch effort for Tak Bai massacre justice","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"May 1, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/01/thailand-last-ditch-effort-tak-bai-massacre-justice","summary":"Persistent impunity in Tak Bai undercut any claim of even-handed treatment of a Muslim minority and a restive border region. This is one of the strongest negative items for fairness across regions and groups.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.4","5B.9"]},{"title":"Srettha to work relentlessly to solve Myanmar crisis","publisher":"Bangkok Post, reporting Bloomberg News","date":"May 24, 2024","url":"https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2798697/thailand-working-relentlessly-to-solve-myanmar-crisis-srettha","summary":"Srettha’s framing stressed spillover reduction and humanitarian stability around the border, which is indirect positive evidence for not abandoning border communities. It is weaker than the rights evidence, but it helps on regional distribution.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.6","5B.7"]},{"title":"Srettha publicly tied government to democracy, rule of law, and human rights","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"March 20, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/summit-for-democracy-3-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"The official statement is supportive intent evidence, but it is still only rhetoric. It weighs slightly positive because it does not signal deliberate favoritism or scapegoating.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.7","5B.9"]},{"title":"Thailand said it promotes human rights for all, humanitarian assistance to all in need, dialogue, reconciliation, and inclusive societies","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"February 28, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/statement-vfm-280224?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c3060006848","summary":"This is broad inclusive rhetoric and modest positive evidence against class-, region-, or identity-based exclusion. It is not proof of equal distribution in practice, but it does cut against overt favoritism.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.7","5B.9"]}]}
